scope: Saudi Exchange identity/source/period validation at a single representative session date; no investment advice.
marketTimeZone: Asia/Riyadh (Saudi Exchange source says Arabian Standard Time, GMT+03:00)
interval: 1d; raw per-session OHLCV. App request window is five years ending at as-of date; the official comparison is for this one date only.

appMethod.functions: upstream(url,true,0) then canonical parseChart(data, asOf); no configuredReader, DB, live application endpoint, source telemetry, or analysis write was used.
appMethod.fieldMapping: symbol/meta.symbol; company/meta.longName plus static Saudi directory; exchange/meta.exchangeName/fullExchangeName; currency/meta.currency; date from timestamp plus meta.gmtoffset; OHLCV from indicators.quote[0] (open/high/low/close/volume); historical price parser reads close, not adjclose.
appMethod.rounding: Compare prices at published two-decimal precision; retain binary floats unchanged in normalized-app-results.json. Volume compared as exact integer shares.

officialSources.retrieval: Official source content returned by web-search result; direct page open returned 403 in this research environment. We did not bypass it.
officialSources.searchFreshness: Search result displayed Published/Crawled approximately 3 weeks before 2026-10-03; reported Market Date remains 2026/09/10.

officialSources.sourceAsOf: Current profile fetched through search index; direct page access returned 403 in this research environment.
officialSources.retrieval: Official profile excerpt visible in web search results; no access-control bypass attempted.
quoteExcerpts: Historical prices & volume traded data are adjusted to account for all corporate actions.
Long name: Saudi Arabian Oil Company / Short Name: Saudi Aramco
open Sunday through Thursday from 10AM to 3PM Arabian Standard Time (GMT +03:00)

corporateActionDisclosure.appBehavior: Canonical parseChart reads the quote close array and event records; it does not read adjclose. Raw chart payload includes provider-supplied dividend/split events (see raw response bundle). The normalized sample is an as-traded single-session OHLCV comparison, not total return.
corporateActionDisclosure.officialContext: Saudi Exchange company-profile pages separately state that historical price and volume series are adjusted for corporate actions. The comparison here uses a Detailed Daily Report row for the stated market date, not that adjusted historical profile series. Full window/corporate-action equivalence was not established.
